items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I just want to say that Buckwheat told Dave Guard about the Concept.

ctx.x: I just want to say that Buckwheat told Dave Guard about the Concept. Dave Guard was knocked out too. So, if you’re familiar with them, the Kingston Trio was very, very popular at that – top of the list.
I do remember that they were popular, yes.
